provenance.how: constructed from the ADR's literals at the pinned ref and cross-checked against the core's own builders (tests/unit/mobile/test_push_wire_contract.py); not captured from a running relay, because no relay route emits the machine-side shapes yet

notes: device_key is minted and returned by EVERY register call, so this response is its only delivery path; a re-register re-mints it (registry-register-rotation.json).
registered_at is the RECORD's stamp, not the request's clock: the app re-registers on every launch and a value that moved under it would make 'registered' unanchored.
token is validated and dropped by the machine (no push token is stored); it must never be echoed here. install_id is the app's identity, not the machine's wire.
forbidden[] is the store's other fields, not a second vocabulary: the response is the contract, not the record's dump.
